nodes.speaker: Old Hollin
nodes.text: *cough* ...You came. The Krug... they poured over the ridge at dawn. Burned everything. I'm finished, friend — don't argue with an old man.

choices.text: Who did this? Krug never come this far west.
Hold on, Hollin. Tell me what to do.

nodes.speaker: Old Hollin
nodes.text: Krug... dozens of them, bolder than I've ever seen. Something drives them from the canyons — and a great Braak runs at the head of the pack.

choices.text: Then someone has to stop them.

nodes.speaker: Old Hollin
nodes.text: Glacern. The garrison at Glacern must be warned. Follow the road east — through the fields, through the canyons. Take my potions. They're no use to me now.

choices.text: I'll reach Glacern. I swear it.

nodes.speaker: Old Hollin
nodes.text: Good... Ehb needs... (Old Hollin's grip loosens, and he breathes his last.)

actions: story:Old Hollin is dead. Krug howls echo from the burning barn to the east.

nodes.speaker: Merik
nodes.text: Easy! I nearly put an arrow in you — thought you were another Krug. They torched my lodge. I've been picking them off from the treeline since sunrise.

choices.text: Come with me. I'm bound for Glacern.

nodes.speaker: Merik
nodes.text: Glacern? Better than waiting for them to find me. My bow is yours — I'll cover you from behind.

nodes.speaker: Sister Ilsa
nodes.text: Travellers, out of the canyons alive? Come, rest by the shrine. The old powers of Ehb still answer here.

nodes.speaker: Sister Ilsa
nodes.text: There. The Krug have never dared this road before... Glacern will need every hand. Will you take mine?

choices.text: Keep the shrine safe. We go on alone.

nodes.speaker: Sister Ilsa
nodes.text: Then let nature's grace go with us. I will keep you standing.

nodes.speaker: Captain of the Guard
nodes.text: Halt! ...Farmers, out of the west? Through the canyons? Speak, and quickly.

choices.text: The Krug have overrun the farmlands. Old Hollin is dead.

nodes.speaker: Captain of the Guard
nodes.text: Then it's worse than the reports said. A Braak leading Krug... Something stirs beneath Ehb. You have done the kingdom a service today. Glacern's gates are open to you.

choices.text: We'll be ready when you need us.
